findings.title: Decimal.usd formatter has no test
findings.failure_scenario: Change the locale to another region, or change .currency(code:) so it renders "1.234,50 USD" or drops the cents. Every test still passes because nothing calls .usd, so the confirmation or receipt screens would show a wrongly formatted amount.
findings.evidence: AmountInput.swift:72-74 `public var usd: String { formatted(.currency(code: "USD").locale(Locale(identifier: "en_US"))) }`. AmountInputTests.swift (lines 1-78) contains no reference to `.usd`.
findings.fix: Add a test, for example #expect(Decimal(string: "1234.5")!.usd == "$1,234.50") and #expect(Decimal(0).usd == "$0.00").
findings.verification_note: I read AmountInput.swift and AmountInputTests.swift in the worktree. The factual part holds: `Decimal.usd` is at AmountInput.swift:72-74, and no test calls it. It still doesn't count as a verified defect. (1) The failure scenario is made up. The current code formats with an explicit en_US locale and USD code, which gives "$1,234.50" as the doc comment and the PLAN assumptions require. Nothing goes wrong as the code stands. The scenario only says a future edit would go uncaught, and that is a coverage gap, not a wrong outcome I can trace. (2) The cited rule P9 (testing-playbook §3) doesn't apply. P9 requires a test change in the same module's Tests for a changed Core file, and this change adds AmountInputTests.swift in AppCoreTests, so P9 is met. (3) The task's PLAN Scope and Acceptance in the context pack list press, display and canSend, plus the exact test cases. `.usd` isn't in this task's scope or acceptance list. A coverage gap like this is something `mutate` would flag at the ready tier as a surviving mutant on a changed line, if the line is new in this change. It isn't a reproducible defect and it isn't a P9 violation. At most it is a minor test-coverage suggestion.

notes:
Implemented AmountInput.press (digits, one point, delete; max 2 fraction digits; 7 whole digits; "0"+"7" -> "7"; "." on empty -> "0."; delete on "0." -> ""), AmountInput.display ("$" + grouped whole + "." + typed fraction, "$0" when empty), and BalanceRules.canSend(amount > 0 && amount <= balance). Public signatures unchanged from the contract stubs. Gate: prove 9 of 9 tests fail with source reverted.
